name: com.gitbook.sites.mcp/site_Fud7X
title: Kognitos Documentation MCP Server
description: Search and read the Kognitos Documentation documentation over MCP.

tools.name: searchDocumentation
tools.description: Search across the documentation to find relevant information, code examples, API references, and guides. Use this tool when you need to answer questions about Kognitos Documentation, find specific documentation, understand how features work, or locate implementation details. The search returns contextual content with titles and direct links to the documentation pages.

tools.name: getPage
tools.description: Fetch the full markdown content of a specific documentation page from Kognitos Documentation. Use this when you have a page URL and want to read its content. Accepts full URLs (e.g. https://docs.kognitos.com//getting-started). Since `searchDocumentation` returns partial content, use `getPage` to retrieve the complete page when you need more details. The content includes links you can follow to navigate to related pages.

tools.name: askQuestion
tools.description: Ask a natural-language question about Kognitos Documentation and get a synthesized answer, with links to the source pages. Prefer this over `searchDocumentation` when you want a direct answer to a question rather than a list of matching pages; use `searchDocumentation`/`getPage` when you need to browse or read full pages yourself.

tools.name: sendFeedback
tools.description: Report an issue in the documentation of Kognitos Documentation so the team can fix it. Use it whenever, while helping a user, you come across content that is outdated, contradictory, missing information, or otherwise unhelpful. Also use it when the user themselves reports a problem with the docs, even if you could not verify it yourself. If it's your own observation, do a quick sanity check that the issue is real before reporting — no need to exhaustively re-read the page. Send one call per distinct issue and do not report the same issue twice in a conversation. Do not use this tool to confirm that a page is accurate; it is for reporting problems only.
